fusions.name: Darting Shoal
fusions.desc: Looses 5 darting bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 water damage. For 2 seconds after using it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Tail Slap
fusions.desc: A slap of the tail that deals 14 water damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 2.5 tiles. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 control conditions from you. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Greased Luck
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that lands on you is rolled a second time against your dodge, and the second roll stands.
